source.accepted_proposal: MP009 distinguishes exposure summaries from response-linked ranking, uses conditional PD/MIC/threshold inputs and defers numerical fitting. Increase its review priority while retaining independently applicable PK/index branches.

profile.name: Data requirements for PK/PD index analysis
outputs: Missing conditional MIC, threshold or PD inputs
profile.applies_when: The project requests exposure indices or comparison of their relationship to a measured response. Distinguish exposure-summary tasks from response-linked index ranking. Reuse existing PK, unit, provenance and MP007 binding assessments rather than repeating them.
required_inputs: The project-defined task and candidate index definitions, exposure windows and concentration basis; specify whether MIC normalization is intended.
Source-linked PK observations or reported exposure inputs relevant to the requested indices, retaining their existing evidence status and unresolved prerequisites.
conditional_inputs: For exposure-response analysis or index ranking: the measured PD endpoint, baseline/comparator, response observation time/window and source, plus traceable mapping among regimen, exposure and response.
For a time-above-threshold index: the threshold and its definition, exposure profile input, analysis window and whether the output is a duration or percentage. A bare fT label is incomplete.
Strain-matched MIC with its measurement context, units and source only when an index is MIC-normalized or uses MIC as its threshold.
For free-exposure indices: use the relevant direct free-concentration or binding-input assessment under MP007.
acceptable_alternatives: Explicitly requested non-MIC-normalized exposure summaries do not require MIC merely because this is a PK/PD task.
When response data or matching are unavailable, retain independently supported exposure-summary tasks and the unresolved ranking objective.
In vitro response data may be registered for their own stated analysis context, without relabeling them as animal efficacy.
data_checks: Determine whether the request is exposure calculation alone or response-linked index comparison. Require PD response/matching inputs only for the latter.
Check each index definition and window. Do not infer MIC normalization, an fT threshold or duration-versus-percentage meaning from an abbreviated label.
For response-linked tasks, map regimen, exposure and PD observations using source-supported relationships. Preserve ambiguity rather than inventing pairs.
For MIC-dependent tasks, verify that the susceptibility input refers to the relevant strain and measurement context. Do not borrow another drug's MIC or PD target to fill gaps.
Report available, absent and unresolved inputs separately by task. Do not fit Emax/Hill models, compute fit statistics or select a winning index in this stage.
profile.missing_effect: Report which index input or exposure-response mapping is missing through the general data-gap policy. Missing PD matching does not block independent PK or exposure-summary work, but exposure values alone do not establish a best index.
not_established: A fitted exposure-response relationship, best index, PD target or evidence of clinical efficacy.
